planets.name: WASP-156 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-156 with a 3.84-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: WASP-156 b was found in 2017 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-156. Its orbit and size follow Lafarga et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
